        manager = row[manager_col]

                raise ValueError(f'Missing or invalid cost for manager {manager}, project {project}')
            cost[manager][project] = cost_val
    if len(managers) != len(projects):
        raise ValueError('Number of managers and projects must be equal for assignment problem.')

        for project in projects:
            if project not in cost[manager]:
